On affected tag 2.4.8 (94b8544e82fd84d1443060cddb5481b7fd462de2), PUT /V1/guest-carts/:cartId/order and POST /V1/guest-carts/:cartId/payment-information are resource anonymous. GuestPaymentInformationManagement calls GuestCartManagementInterface::placeOrder(). Checkout plugins VerifyIsGuestCheckoutEnabledBeforePlaceOrder/SavePaymentInformation call Checkout\Helper\Data::isAllowedGuestCheckout, which dispatches checkout_allow_guest only when checkout/options/guest_checkout is true.

Magento\Downloadable\Observer\IsAllowedGuestCheckoutObserver vetoes downloadable guest checkout when catalog/downloadable/disable_guest_checkout is set or selected links are not shareable. At 2.4.8 that observer is registered only in app/code/Magento/Downloadable/etc/frontend/events.xml; REST/SOAP/GraphQL areas omit it, so API-area order placement skips the Downloadable authorization veto.

Unique common 2.4.8 -> 2.4.8-p1 authorization delta is addition of Downloadable etc/graphql/events.xml, etc/webapi_rest/events.xml, and etc/webapi_soap/events.xml registering the same observer. 2.4.5-p12/2.4.6-p10 also lacked the Checkout API guest-check plugins, which 2.4.5-p13/2.4.6-p11 backported together with those event files.

findings: CVE-2025-43585 is a real published Adobe CWE-285 security-feature bypass: anonymous Web API guest order placement skips Magento_Downloadable's checkout_allow_guest veto because that observer is registered only in the frontend area.

Primary introducer_sha 7f25fa6a5ec0639cbb2ac63d82fc73f4cd397b59 is not the BIC. Parent 1d941ba7a09a964569f5a14c4590c219b16b7f3c already had anonymous PUT /V1/guest-carts/:cartId/order -> GuestCartManagementInterface::placeOrder. 7f25fa6a is a later payment-information convenience wrapper around that sink.

Correct BIC is 14cdb650cb58ba620baeb3443331194c39b9a845, which first added the anonymous guest-carts order route while Downloadable isAllowedGuestCheckout was already frontend-only. Immediate parent 9a0fbce28ec1c4baccb52623d47b992d48ee88ee lacks that route.

ACP2E-1339 47c388a093fd5621b19eb2089877db80254a937a (2022-11-07, soumah <soumah@adobe.com>) later attached isAllowedGuestCheckout plugins to guest API services, so on 2.4.7-p5/2.4.8 general Allow Guest Checkout is enforced over API, but the Downloadable observer still does not run in REST/SOAP/GraphQL. That is incomplete remediation of the same authorization gap, not a new AI introducer.
Human BIC authorship in 2015 (Anup Dugar, no AI/bot/generator markers) supports NOT_AI. Primary verdict NOT_AI is correct; introducer identity and flaw_origin need correction.

Direct closing change is registration of IsAllowedGuestCheckoutObserver in webapi_rest, webapi_soap, and graphql areas (develop e56d704d618385aeb5e6253e2ecd755abb23e1e8; release packaging 2.4.8-p1 10fdaddfd21f922d0c1b4f9f889dba8cfd4be8d6 and 2.4.5-p13 9bf2c06ea8c9fc52698f4e9994b5334a436649ad, the latter also backporting Checkout guest-check plugins).

corrected_fields.bug_semantics: Anonymous Web API guest order placement (first PUT /V1/guest-carts/:cartId/order, later also POST /V1/guest-carts/:cartId/payment-information) reaches GuestCartManagementInterface::placeOrder without running Magento_Downloadable's checkout_allow_guest observer. That observer vetoes guest checkout when catalog/downloadable/disable_guest_checkout is set or selected links are not shareable, but it is registered only in frontend/events.xml, so REST/SOAP/GraphQL areas omit the authorization veto. After ACP2E-1339, API plugins call isAllowedGuestCheckout (dispatching checkout_allow_guest when general guest checkout is on) yet still miss the Downloadable observer. The APSB25-50 fix registers the observer in webapi_rest, webapi_soap, and graphql areas and backports the guest-check plugins onto 2.4.5/2.4.6.
corrected_fields.flaw_origin: 14cdb650cb58ba620baeb3443331194c39b9a845 is the smallest public first-write of the complete anonymous HTTP order sink: it added the anonymous PUT /V1/guest-carts/:cartId/order route to GuestCartManagementInterface::placeOrder. Immediate parent 9a0fbce28ec1c4baccb52623d47b992d48ee88ee already had the GuestCartManagement implementation but no guest-carts order route, while Downloadable's isAllowedGuestCheckout observer was already registered only in frontend/events.xml. 7f25fa6a5ec0639cbb2ac63d82fc73f4cd397b59 is a later additional payment-information wrapper around the same placeOrder sink, not the BIC.
